On some days, a group of nomads sets up camp at one of four possible locations in the Kha'labal desert, near Ankrahmun. Three of these camps have a chest you can open once per activation. Opening all three chests (on different days) gives you the achievement **Chest Robber**.
The nomads travel across the desert and set up camp in several places.
One of the 4 possible camps (northeast of the Shadow Tomb)
The mini world change has to be active that day on your world.
camp north-east of the Ancient Ruins Tomb
camp north-east of the Shadow Tomb
camp south of the Ancient Ruins Tomb: 3 Small Emeralds, 1 Black Pearl, 1 Small Topaz and 1 Silver Amulet
Only one of the four camps appears at a time, and the world change isn't active every day.
Since each activation shows only one camp, you need at least three different days to get **Chest Robber**.
The {creature:Nomad (Blue)|blue nomads} and the {creature:Nomad (Female)|female nomads} only exist during this world change.
When the world change is active, NPCs and heralds talk about it. Look for messages like these:
The camp appears in one of these four locations in {wiki:Kha'labal}, the desert around Ankrahmun. Visit them until you find the nomads.

Go through all four locations. At each one there are different nomads guarding the camp. To get there, take a boat to **Ankrahmun** (say {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} to the captain) and leave the city into the desert. All four locations are on the surface: to come back, just walk back to Ankrahmun.

Come back on other days when the world change is active until you have opened all **three** chests (Shadow Tomb, south and north-east of the Ancient Ruins Tomb). When you open the third one you get the achievement **Chest Robber**.
